observation: I was not sure what to choose before making the first story.
My child wanted to see their favorite animal in another story.
After the first week the activities felt too similar.
I could not tell what skill we were practicing or whether it was improving.
The trial was fun, but I did not know why I should keep paying every month.
A ten-minute bedtime activity fits our routine.
I want to know how stories are checked before my child sees them.
I would consider a yearly option if I knew we would keep using it.
